Elements matching CSS class selector are excluded entirely

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<body><div class="cookie-banner">Accept cookies</div><p>Main content</p></body>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: ['.cookie-banner']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
